info.title: Aidentika Public API
info.description: API для генерации продуктовых фото, карточек, видео и работы с AI-помощниками.

post.description:
Upload an image for reuse across multiple generation requests.
Returns an upload_id valid for 1 hour. Use it in place of base64 data
in generation requests by passing {"upload_id": "..."} instead of {"data": "..."}.
Generate styled product photo(s) from reference images.
Generate video from a source image using AI.
Edit an existing generated image by text instruction.

get.description:
Poll the status of a generation/edit/video action.
Returns result URL when completed.

post.description:
Cancel a pending/queued action. Only works if the action hasn't started processing yet.
If the generation is already in progress, cancellation is best-effort.
Tokens held for cancelled actions are released automatically.

get.description:
Download the result of a completed action.
Redirects to the signed asset URL.
Returns status message if the action is not yet completed.
Get current token pricing for all operations.

Get all product categories with their shooting concepts.

Response is cached for 24 hours (categories never change).

post.description: Generate marketing text suggestion from product photos.
Generate AI-suggested video scenario for a product image.

get.description: Get current daily AI helper usage for the API key owner.

post.description: Register a webhook to receive event notifications.

get.description: List all registered webhooks (no secrets shown).

List your past generation results with pagination.

Returns fresh signed URLs for completed results (valid 30 days).
Use GET /status/{action_id} to get a fresh URL for any individual result.

GenerateAllRequest.title: GenerateAllRequest
GenerateAllRequest.description:
Явный состав запуска (money-path): фронт шлёт id включённых карточек, которые
юзер видел в цене на кнопке. Сервер запускает ПЕРЕСЕЧЕНИЕ этого списка со своим
фактическим набором (idle/failed + непустой текст) — списание никогда
не превышает показанное. None/пустое тело (старый клиент) — прежнее поведение:
все подходящие.
